lang.sub: Auto follows your device. Anything not translated yet stays in English.
lang.title: Language
review.ai.err: Could not reach the AI just now.
review.ai.note: Written by {who} from the facts above. Check it against your own list.
review.ai.reject: That recap did not match your tasks closely enough, so it was not used. The summary above is what your planner knows.
review.card.laterAria: Not now, hide the review for today
review.card.quiet: Here is a quick look back at {when}.
review.card.slip: {n} task could use a new day.|{n} tasks could use a new day.
review.card.title: Your week in review
review.done.none: A quieter week for finishing tasks. That happens, and a fresh week is right around the corner.
review.done.steps: {n} step along the way|{n} steps along the way
review.exam.none: No exams or quizzes in the next three weeks.
review.exam.tip: When one is added, Exam Prep can build a study plan for it.
review.idea.early: The week ahead looks like {level}. Starting "{title}" a little early would give you room.
review.idea.first: Choose "{title}" as your first task for the week so it is easy to begin.
review.idea.prep: "{title}" is coming up and has no study plan yet. Exam Prep can make one in a minute.
review.idea.rest: Enjoy the quiet. Nothing is pressing, so resting is a fine plan.
review.idea.slipped: Pick one of the dates that passed, "{title}", and give it a day. Small steps count.
review.movedall: Gave {n} task a new day|Gave {n} tasks a new day
review.plan.head: The main things: {what}.
review.plan.none: Nothing is scheduled yet. A quiet week is a fine week.
review.set.sub: A calm summary of your week. The card shows on the Board from Sunday afternoon through Monday.
review.set.title: Weekly Review
review.slip.intro: These are still open and their dates have passed. Give each a new day, or leave them be.
review.slip.moved: {n} due date was moved this week.|{n} due dates were moved this week.
review.slip.none: Nothing is waiting on a new date. That is a tidy list.
review.streak: You had {n} study day this week.|You had {n} study days this week.
review.time.est: The tasks you finished were estimated at about {time} in all.
review.time.none: No focus time was tracked, so there is no study time to show.
review.time.note: Time is approximate. It comes from your focus sessions and any time you logged.
review.time.tip: Start a focus timer on a task and it will show up here next week.
review.title: Weekly Review
review.toast.later: Okay, I will leave it for now. You can find it in Settings any time.
review.toast.skip: Skipped this week. It will be back next Sunday.
review.undone: Put back the way it was.
streak.about: A study day is a day you finished a task, tracked focus time, ticked a checklist step or reviewed flashcards. Opening the app does not count, and a quiet day never takes your progress away.
streak.best: Best run: {n}. It stays, whatever happens next.
streak.chip.month: {n} study day this month|{n} study days this month
streak.chip.run: {n} study day in a row|{n} study days in a row
streak.grid.aria: The last five weeks. Tap a day that is not a study day to mark or unmark it as a rest day.
streak.intro.p: Optional. It counts days you actually study, not days you open the app. Rest days never break it, and a quiet day never resets it.
streak.line.month: {n} study day in the last 4 weeks. Rest days never break this.|{n} study days in the last 4 weeks. Rest days never break this.
streak.line.run: {n} study days in a row, and {k} in the last 4 weeks.
streak.line.start: Any small step today starts a gentle streak. Rest days never break it.
streak.say.back1: Welcome back. I am glad you are here. Let's pick up gently.
streak.say.back2: There you are. It is good to study with you again.
streak.say.m14a: Two weeks of steady study days. That takes real care.
streak.say.m14b: {n} study days in a row. Look at you go.
streak.say.m21a: Three weeks of study days. This is turning into a real habit.
streak.say.m21b: {n} days in a row. Your future self says thank you.
streak.say.m30a: {n} study days in a row. Look how far this has come.
streak.say.m30b: {n} days of steady work. I am so happy to study beside you.
streak.say.m3a: {n} study days in a row. That is a lovely rhythm.
streak.say.m3b: {n} days of showing up. You are settling into something good.
streak.say.m7a: A whole week of study days. I noticed, and I am proud of you.
streak.say.m7b: Seven study days in a row. What a steady week.
streak.set.free.sub: A quiet day is covered by a free rest day, up to this many a week. {left} left this week.
streak.set.off: Off. A streak that counts study days and forgives quiet ones.
streak.set.title: Gentle Study Streak
streak.set.wd.sub: These weekdays never break the streak, and they do not use up the free rest days.
streak.soft: Your run is resting at a gentler number until your next study day.
streak.sum.calm: Rest days never break this. Any small step today counts.
streak.sum.month: study day in the last 4 weeks|study days in the last 4 weeks
streak.sum.pause: A pause is fine. Your next study day picks up from here.
streak.sum.run: {n} study day in a row.|{n} study days in a row.
streak.title: Study Streak
streak.toast.no: No problem. You can turn it on any time in Settings, under Study and AI.
streak.toast.off: Gentle streak is off. Your progress is kept if you turn it back on.
streak.toast.on: Gentle streak is on. Rest days never break it.
streak.today.rest: Take Today as a Rest Day
streak.today.unrest: Today is a rest day. Undo
streak.toggle.sub: When on, it replaces the fire streak line. Your original progress counter keeps running quietly, so rewards still arrive.
